sections.title: باب 7 — متن (42)

sections.theory:
Strike Zone

The strike zone is that area which is below the shoulder and above the knee of the one batting at the home plate. The chief umpire will determine this area. Usually it is determined when the batter is standing straight.

Strike

When the batter does not hit the ball thrown by the pitcher (Pitcher), or swings the bat but the ball is wasted from him, then the umpire will call strike (Strike). The umpire will also call strike when the player hits the ball in such a way that it goes into the foul area.

Ball

When the pitcher (Pitcher) throws four balls outside the strike zone and the batter does not play them, “ball” will be called. In such a case the batter will go to the second base.

Running

The batter becomes a runner at that time when:

he has played the ball without the foul area.

when the keeper has dropped the catch.

Duration of the game

The game consists of specific innings, which is decided before the start of the match. The professional competitions of America consist of nine (9) innings. When all the players of each side have played on their turns, it will be counted one innings. A half innings will be counted when three players of some team are out. At the end of the decided innings, if the score is equal, extra innings will be played until a clear lead appears in the score of one team.

کھیل مخصوص انگز پر مشتمل ہوتا ہے۔ جس کا فیصلہ میچ کے آغاز سے قبل کیا جاتا ہے۔ امریکہ کے پروفیشنل مقابلے نو (9) انگز پر مشتمل ہوتے ہیں۔ ہر سائیڈ کے تمام کھلاڑی اپنی اپنی باری پر کھیلیں گے تو ایک انگز شمار ہوگی۔ ہاف انگز اس وقت شمار ہوگی جب کسی ٹیم کے تین کھلاڑی آؤٹ ہو جائیں۔ طے شدہ انگز کے اختتام پر اگر سکور برابر ہو جائے تو ایکسٹرا انگز کھیلی جائے گی تاوقتیکہ کسی ایک ٹیم کے سکور میں واضح برتری نہ ہو جائے۔
